hero.subtitle: One title. One rule. Follow the living history of the ToNOI match by match.

about.heading: What is the ToNOI?
about.paragraph1: Can you imagine what would happen if football decided its champion the way boxing does? We're here to tell you all about it.
about.paragraph2: The Unofficial Tournament of England (ToNOI) is a championship in which to become champion you must beat the current champion. There are no group stages, knockouts or anything like that: only finals. If you face the champion team and come out victorious, you'll become the new UNOFFICIAL CHAMPION OF ENGLAND and start making history until you're defeated by another team.
about.paragraph3: The title changes hands match by match, spanning decades, generations and rivalries. Here neither the league nor the cup matter: the only thing that counts is that particular duel where a club challenges the current champion.
about.closing: Join us on this adventure and enjoy football like never before.

rules.title: Official Rules
items: If you beat the current champion, you become champion.
If a league has no official records, the next official match will be counted.
If the champion club ceases to exist, the title returns to the previous champion.
Extra time only counts if the match was level after 90 minutes.
Penalties count: if the match ends level overall or requires a tiebreaker, the winner takes the title.
